integrity: All two- and three-agent profiles are exhaustively checked with two serial-dictatorship implementations and two exact rank-maximality implementations; all perfect matchings are explicitly enumerated.
scientific_limitations: The complete classification covers only balanced strict complete one-sided markets through three agents and one fixed serial-dictatorship priority; larger markets, random priorities, ties, incomplete lists, and capacities are outside scope.
title: Exact first rank-maximality failure of serial dictatorship
